pairs: Now these are the generations of Esau,
Esau accepit uxores de filiabus Chanaan:
Esau took wives from the daughters of Canaan:
Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite,
et Oolibama filiam Anæ filiæ Sebeon Hevæi:
and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,
Basemath quoque filiam Ismaël sororem Nabaioth.
and Basemath, the daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebaioth.
Oolibama genuit Jehus et Ihelon et Core.
Oholibamah conceived Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah.
Hi filii Esau qui nati sunt ei in terra Chanaan.
These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
and every soul of his house,
et cuncta quæ habere poterat in terra Chanaan:
and whatever he was able to obtain in the land of Canaan,
and he went into another region,
For they were very wealthy and were not able to live together.
Neither was the land of their sojourn able to sustain them,
nec sustinebat eos terra peregrinationis eorum præ multitudine gregum.
because of the multitude of their flocks.
And Esau lived at mount Seir:
Hæ autem sunt generationes Esau patris Edom in monte Seir,
So these are the generations of Esau, the father of Edom, at mount Seir,
and these are the names of his sons:
Eliphaz the son of Adah, the wife of Esau,
Rahuel quoque filius Basemath uxoris ejus.
likewise Reuel, the son of Basemath, his wife.
Erat autem Thamna concubina Eliphaz filii Esau:
Now Timna was the concubine of Eliphaz, the son of Esau.
Hi sunt filii Ada uxoris Esau.
These are the sons of Adah, the wife of Esau.
And the sons of Reuel were Nahath and Zerah,
These are the sons of Basemath,
Isti quoque erant filii Oolibama filiæ Anæ filiæ Sebeon,
Likewise, these were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah,
the daughter of Zibeon, the wife of Esau,
These were leaders of the sons of Esau,
the sons of Eliphaz, the firstborn of Esau:
Hi filii Eliphaz in terra Edom,
These are the sons of Eliphaz, in the land of Edom,
and these the sons of Adah.
Hi quoque filii Rahuel filii Esau:
Likewise, these are the sons of Reuel, the son of Esau:
hi autem duces Rahuel in terra Edom:
And these were the leaders of Reuel, in the land of Edom.
These are the sons of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
Hi autem filii Oolibama uxoris Esau:
Now these are the sons of Oholibamah, the wife of Esau:
hi duces Oolibama filiæ Anæ uxoris Esau.
These were the leaders of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah and the wife of Esau.
These are the sons of Esau,
These are the sons of Seir, the Horite,
the inhabitants of the land: Lotan,
These were the leaders of the Horites,
the sons of Seir, in the land of Edom.
But the sister of Lotan was Timna.
And these are the sons of Shobal:
And these are the sons of Zibeon:
Iste est Ana qui invenit aquas calidas in solitudine,
This is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness,
cum pasceret asinos Sebeon patris sui:
when he was pasturing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.
And he had a son Dishon,
And these are the sons of Dishon:
Likewise, these are the sons of Ezer:
These were the leaders of the Horites:
isti duces Horræorum qui imperaverunt in terra Seir.
These were leaders of the Horites who ruled in the land of Seir.
Reges autem qui regnaverunt in terra Edom antequam haberent regem filii Israël,
Now before the sons of Israel had a king,
the kings who ruled in the land of Edom were these:
and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
et regnavit pro eo Jobab filius Zaræ de Bosra.
the son of Zerah from Bozrah, reigned in his place.
regnavit pro eo Husam de terra Themanorum.
Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
regnavit pro eo Adad filius Badad,
Hadad the son of Bedad reigned in his place.
qui percussit Madian in regione Moab:
He struck down Midian in the region of Moab.
And the name of his city was Avith.
regnavit pro eo Semla de Masreca.
Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
Hoc quoque mortuo regnavit pro eo Saul de fluvio Rohoboth.
Likewise, this one being dead, Shaul of the river Rehoboth, reigned in his place.
And when he also had passed away,
successit in regnum Balanan filius Achobor.
Baal-hanan, the son of Achbor, succeeded to the kingdom.
Isto quoque mortuo regnavit pro eo Adar,
Likewise, this one being dead, Hadar reigned in his place;
and the name of his city was Pau.
And his wife was called Mehetabel,
the daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.
Hæc ergo nomina ducum Esau in cognationibus,
Therefore, these were the names of the leaders of Esau, by their families,
hi duces Edom habitantes in terra imperii sui,
These were the leaders of Edom living in the land of their rule:
this is Esau, the father of Idumea.
